functions.name: claim_jobs
functions.definition:
-- Materialized so the locking subquery runs once; an IN (...) subquery can be
  -- re-evaluated by the planner and claim more than `batch` rows.
  with next as materialized (
    select c.id from better_supabase.jobs c
    where c.queue = claim_jobs.queue
      and (
        (c.status = 'queued' and c.run_at <= now())
        or (c.status = 'running' and c.locked_until < now())
      )
    order by c.priority desc, c.run_at, c.id
    for update skip locked
    limit batch
  )
  update better_supabase.jobs j
  set status = 'running',
      attempts = j.attempts + 1,
      locked_by = worker,
      locked_until = now() + lease
  from next
  where j.id = next.id
  returning j.*

functions.name: enqueue_job
functions.complete_statement:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION better_supabase.enqueue_job(queue text, payload jsonb DEFAULT '{}'::jsonb, run_at timestamp with time zone DEFAULT now(), max_attempts integer DEFAULT 5, dedupe_key text DEFAULT NULL::text, priority integer DEFAULT 0)
 RETURNS bigint
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
#variable_conflict use_column
declare
  job_id bigint;
begin
  insert into better_supabase.jobs (queue, payload, run_at, max_attempts, dedupe_key, priority)
  values (queue, payload, run_at, max_attempts, dedupe_key, priority)
  on conflict (queue, dedupe_key) where dedupe_key is not null and status in ('queued', 'running')
  do nothing
  returning id into job_id;
  if job_id is null then
    select j.id into job_id from better_supabase.jobs j
    where j.queue = enqueue_job.queue and j.dedupe_key = enqueue_job.dedupe_key
      and j.status in ('queued', 'running');
  end if;
  return job_id;
end;
$function$
functions.argument_types: queue text, payload jsonb DEFAULT '{}'::jsonb, run_at timestamp with time zone DEFAULT now(), max_attempts integer DEFAULT 5, dedupe_key text DEFAULT NULL::text, priority integer DEFAULT 0
functions.identity_argument_types: queue text, payload jsonb, run_at timestamp with time zone, max_attempts integer, dedupe_key text, priority integer

functions.name: fail_job
functions.definition:
update better_supabase.jobs
  set status = case when attempts >= max_attempts then 'dead' else 'queued' end,
      run_at = case
        when attempts >= max_attempts then run_at
        else now() + coalesce(retry_in, least(interval '1 hour', interval '1 second' * power(2, attempts)))
      end,
      finished_at = case when attempts >= max_attempts then now() end,
      last_error = left(error, 4000),
      locked_by = null,
      locked_until = null
  where id = job_id and locked_by = worker and status = 'running'
  returning status

    when slug is null then null
    when slug !~ '^[a-z0-9](?:[a-z0-9-]{0,61}[a-z0-9])?$' then 'invalid'

AS $function$
